name: ecomflow-ai
description: WorkBuddy expert for human assisted cross-border ecommerce customer service.

displayDescription.zh: 协助跨境电商客服识别买家诉求，核查商品、订单、物流和售后资料，生成中文说明与美式英文回复。
displayDescription.en: Helps human agents verify ecommerce facts with available tools and draft concise US English customer replies.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请判断这条英文买家咨询，并在核查可用数据后起草英文回复。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Classify this buyer question, verify available data, and draft a reply.
